parameter_matrix.note: Wider operating Vin window supports broader rail & battery chemistry headroom.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.

parameter_matrix.part_a_value: ESR-Sensitive · >=22 µF · See datasheet ESR curve
parameter_matrix.note: Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: CRITICAL CAPACITOR ESR OSCILLATION RISK: TLV1117-33IDCYR is stable with low-ESR ceramic MLCCs (>= 1 µF, p.26), whereas AMS1117-3.3 is NOT ceramic-cap stable (ESR window: See datasheet ESR curve). Using an ultra-low-ESR MLCC on AMS1117-3.3 can trigger control-loop oscillation.
BENCH VERIFICATION: Confirm thermal dissipation margin using θJA (AMS1117-3.3: 90 °C/W vs TLV1117-33IDCYR: 95.4 °C/W) and worst-case ambient temperature (-40..125 °C vs -40..125 °C).
engineering_verdict: AMS1117-3.3 (Advanced Monolithic Systems, SOT-223-3) and TLV1117-33IDCYR (Texas Instruments, SOT-223-3) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required replacements: while the footprint is physically compatible, engineering review and passive/circuit adjustments are mandatory due to ceramic output capacitor ESR stability difference. Key datasheet deltas: Iq is 5000 µA (p.3) vs 65 µA (p.8), max output current is 1000 mA (p.1) vs 800 mA (p.5), recommended Vin,max is 15 V (p.2) vs 15 V (p.5), typical dropout is 1100 mV (p.3) vs 800 mV (p.8), and ceramic capacitor stability is ESR-constrained vs supported. Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.3), thermal margin (θJA 90 vs 95.4 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
